neighbours.label: The boundary after the first of two contrasted alternatives ('some stress X; others Y', 'either X or Y')
fire: In the debate, some speakers stressed the economic costs; others the human toll.
Reviewers praised either the music of the film or its photography.
One camp favored lower taxes, the other more public spending.
Some students preferred the morning class; others the evening one.
Historians have stressed either the political causes of the war or the economic ones.
Half of the town supported the mayor; the other half her rival.
Some doctors emphasize diet; others exercise.
Older fans loved the band's early records, younger fans their later work.
quiet: In the debate, the speakers talked about the economic costs for an hour.
Reviewers praised the music of the film in several newspapers.
The camp by the river was full of families in the summer.
The students arrived early for the morning class on Monday.
Historians have written many books about the causes of the war.
The town held a parade for the mayor in the spring.
The doctors at the clinic recommend a balanced diet.
The band played its early records at the concert last night.

notes: Output promotes either/both/respectively/depending. Probes reached only about 0.22.
